title: Contributing
text: submitting bug report, please following: Make sure ’re latest version. problem may solved already. Try older versions. ’re latest release, try rolling back minor versions help narrow problem first arose. Search project’s issue tracker make sure ’s known issue.

title: Contributing
text: Make sure report includes: Operating system: Windows? macOS? Linux? Include version details. R version: Output R.version.string sessionInfo(). Package version: Output packageVersion("documenteR"). RStudio version: addin involved, include RStudio build. Installation method: r-universe, GitHub (devtools::install_github), source. Steps reproduce: Include minimal example, command addin steps used, full output error message.

title: Contributing
text: contributing project, agree contributions licensed terms rest project (see LICENSE file repository root). Per-file copyright/license headers typically needed. Please don’t add copyright headers new files unless project’s license actually requires .

title: Contributing
text: Always make new branch work, matter small. Don’t submit unrelated changes branch/pull request. Base branch main new features bug fixes. PR sidelined , rebase merge latest main resubmitting.

title: Contributing
text: Follow style used repository. Consistency rest project always trumps considerations. Use snake_case functions variables, <- assignment, 2-space indentation.

title: Contributing
text: Documentation required contributions: Roxygen2 comments must created updated exported functions. README pkgdown docs updated user-facing behavior changes. Changelog entry credit contributor change user-visible.

title: Contributing
text: Tests required contributions: Bug fixes must include test proving existence bug fixed. New features must include tests proving actually work. Run devtools::test() locally opening pull request.

title: Contributing
text: ’s example workflow contributing:

title: Contributing
text: Fork repository GitHub. Clone fork: git clone git@github.com:yourname/documenteR.git cd documenteR Install development dependencies: devtools::install_dev_deps() Create branch: git checkout -b fix-description main

title: Contributing
text: Write tests expecting correct/fixed functionality; make sure fail initially. Implement changes. Run tests : devtools::test() Run full check: devtools::check() Update documentation needed. Commit changes: git commit -m "Brief description changes"

title: Contributing
text: Push branch: git push origin HEAD Visit GitHub click “Pull request” button. description field, reference issue number (fixing existing issue) describe issue fix. Submit patient - maintainers review can.

text: questions contributing, please open issue contact maintainers.

text: Open script defines function data frame, highlight object name, run “Document object” addin. addin sources current file, finds selected object, inserts roxygen2 skeleton .

title: Get Started
text: can also generate documentation template directly console. returns roxygen2 skeleton one @param line function argument.
code:
documenteR::documenter("lm") #> [1] "
#' @title FUNCTION_TITLE
#'
#' @description FUNCTION_DESCRIPTION
#'
#' @param formula DESCRIPTION.
#' @param data DESCRIPTION.
#' @param subset DESCRIPTION.
#' @param weights DESCRIPTION.
#' @param na.action DESCRIPTION.
#' @param method DESCRIPTION.
#' @param model DESCRIPTION.
#' @param x DESCRIPTION.
#' @param y DESCRIPTION.
#' @param qr DESCRIPTION.
#' @param singular.ok DESCRIPTION.
#' @param contrasts DESCRIPTION.
#' @param offset DESCRIPTION.
#' @param ... DESCRIPTION.
#'
#' @return RETURN_DESCRIPTION
#' @export
lm"

title: Document an R object — documenter
text: function takes name object (either R function R data.frame) replaces skeleton roxygen2 documentation. used documenter_addin() function installed R addin. functions, empty @param generated funciton's arguments. dataframes, full \description block generated column names

title: Document an R object — documenter
text: objname character string naming R function data.frame. envir optional environment used resolve objname. supplied, documenteR looks environment.

title: Document an R object — documenter
text: addin automatically source file function data .
